1	# Plan: Germanic bakery (Bäckerei) — architect's form
2	
3	Identity: a narrow, gable-to-the-street town bakery. Dark deepslate masonry ground storey with a big shop window either side
4	of the door; a jettied half-timbered upper storey and gable (stripped spruce frame, white daub infill); a steep slate roof
5	with a flour-loft hoist beam at the apex; a lower bakehouse wing on the east whose brick bread oven bulges out at the back
6	under a tall brick chimney. Spruce-forest materials only. All ranges inclusive. Axes: x east (along the street), y up,
7	z south; the front faces NORTH (-z).
8	
9	## SITE
10	Lot 24 (x 0..23) by 32 (z 0..31), height to y=24. Ground block y=0; outdoor walking surface y=1; interior floor blocks
11	y=1 (walk y=2).
12	
13	| mass / feature | x | y | z | notes |
14	|---|---|---|---|---|
15	| ground | 0..23 | 0 | 0..31 | grass_block; podzol + coarse_dirt patches in the yard |
16	| street (lane) | 0..23 | 0 | 0..3 | gravel, kerb of cobbled_deepslate at z=3 |
17	| sidewalk | 0..23 | 0 | 4..7 | cobblestone with mossy_cobblestone flecks (~15%) |
18	| front step | 10..12 | 1 | 8 | cobbled_deepslate_stairs facing north (x=11), cobbled_deepslate_slab at x=10 and x=12 |
19	| MAIN BODY ground storey | 6..16 | 1..5 | 9..22 | deepslate masonry, 11 wide x 14 deep |
20	| MAIN BODY upper storey (jettied) | 6..16 | 6..10 | 8..22 | half-timber; projects 1 north over the shop front (z=8) |
21	| jetty brackets | 6,8,11,14,16 | 5 | 8 | spruce_stairs upside-down, back against the wall (facing south), under the jetty sill |
22	| main roof + front/back gables | 5..17 | 11..21 | 7..23 | steep gable, ridge along z at x=11, y=21 |
23	| BAKEHOUSE WING | 17..21 | 1..5 | 13..22 | single storey, gable end to the street (north face z=13) |
24	| wing roof | 17..22 | 6..8 | 12..23 | gable, ridge along z at x=19 |

39	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
40	| main | steep gable, gable end to the street (north) and back (south) | 2 (preset shop) | along z at x=11, y=21, z=7..23 | 1 all round (eave x=5 and x=17 at y=11; verges z=7, z=23) | `$MCD roof --spec` with `{"preset":"shop","material":"slate","ridgeAxis":"z","front":"n","gable":"white_wool","verge":"spruce","keep":[the gable timber cells + loft opening, see FACADES]}` over footprint [6,8,16,22], eave y=10 (roof from y=11). Tested: roof top y=21, ratio 1.00 (cap 1.8). The tool's dormers do NOT fit this span (dropped) — no dormers; the long slopes are broken on the east by the wing roof and the chimney, on the west they stay plain (accepted: steep unbroken German slate roof). |

Each helper is `name(g, ...)`, writes via `g.set` and the `B.*` block helpers, and returns the cells it wrote. Coordinates are corner-origin unless stated. Shares of ~10 are written at once by separate sessions, in this order.

**Frame and walls**
1. `beamRun(g, axis, a0, a1, fixed, y, fixed2)` — a horizontal `stripped_spruce_wood` run with `axis: x|z`, from a0 to a1 at the given other coordinates. E.g. sill `beamRun(g,"x",6,16,8,6)` (z=8, y=6).

4. `fachwerkWall(g, axis, fixed, a0, a1, y0, y1, posts[], windows[], braced[])` — composes 1–3: posts at `posts`, sill at y0, breast rail at y0+1, head plate at y1, daub between, `windows` = list of [a0,a1,ya,yb] left unset, `braced` = panel indices that get `mannBrace`. 5. `mannBrace(g, x, y, z, toward)` — one `spruce_stairs`, `half: top`, back toward the post at `toward` (e|w|n|s).
6. `masonryWall(g, axis, fixed, a0, a1, y0, y1, {plinth:true, piers:[...], openings:[...]})` — `deepslate_bricks` courses, `polished_deepslate` plinth at y0, optional pier columns (deepslate_bricks, no change of block but listed), openings left unset.
7. `jettyBracket(g, x, y, z)` — `spruce_stairs` `half: top`, back against the wall (`facing: south` for the front jetty), at (x,y,z).
8. `gableFrame(g, z, {king:true, collar:[x0,x1,y]})` — collar beam `stripped_spruce_wood` axis x at y=14 x=8..14, king post `stripped_spruce_log` (11,11..13,z). Front z=8, back z=22. Leaves the cells in RESERVED unset.

**Openings**
9. `glazedWindow(g, axis, x0, x1, y0, y1, fixed)` — `glass_pane` filling the opening with connection states along the wall axis; reveal: nothing proud.
10. `shopWindow(g, x0, x1)` — front shop window: glazedWindow (x0..x1, y=3..4, z=9) + breast `deepslate_bricks` (x0..x1,2,9) + `counterSlab`.
11. `counterSlab(g, x0, x1, z)` — `spruce_slab` `type: top`, x0..x1 at (y=2, z=8).
12. `shutterPair(g, x, y0, y1, z, faceDir)` — two `spruce_trapdoor`s per row, `open: true`, `facing` = the wall side so they lie flat against the wall (use `mcd states spruce_trapdoor`; render to check they don't stand across the window).

# Makes build.nbt from scratch: build to a temp file, run the main roof preset once the shell exists, then move into place.

MCD="/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/bin/mcd.mjs"

  node "$MCD" roof "$TMP" --spec roof.json --dry-run

  mv "$TMP.roof.nbt" "$TMP"
fi

mv "$TMP" build.nbt
echo "make.sh: wrote build.nbt"
